status: RESEARCH PROTOTYPE - preliminary results (batch v4, 5 paired seeds); not yet calibrated or externally validated
implemented: fleet management: dispatch, heartbeat, MRC, kerb capacity
remote-assist queue with feedback from congestion
EMS dispatch cycle with 2 stations / 2 A&E, re-insertion after teleport
EMS probe trips (30/h) for travel-time measurement
batch runner, paired analysis, replay viewer
robust_findings_v4: A2 fleet outage + stop-in-lane is the worst case: background delay +566 +/- 34 veh-h (baseline 122), lane blocking +3314 AV-min, unserved trips +58 pp, ambulance response +7.4 +/- 5.1 min
Policy ordering P0 > P1 > P2 holds for delay and lane blocking under A1 and A2; P2 safe harbour removes ~93% of A2 background delay and the ambulance-response effect
No policy reduces stranded-passenger minutes or assist waits: recovery is bottlenecked by remote-assist capacity
A5 assist flood above operator capacity causes physical blockage (+749 AV-min, +125 veh-h) with no vehicle attacked; below capacity there is no effect (capacity cliff)
weak_or_null_v4: A1 and A5 ambulance-response effects (CI includes 0 at n=5)
A3 ghost bookings: small, not significant
known_issues: one non-reproducible late divergence in 89 runs (size below noise floor)
ambulances: no bluelight device (SUMO crash) - red-light pass only
teleport-off baseline gridlocks in some seeds
